name: Stones Hold
note: Stones Hold is two cities in a mountain range. The UNDER CITY (99% of the people) fills a maze of twelve valleys wall to wall, its streets running round every cliff and bench, with an alpine lake held above it by a dam. The UPPER CITY (1%) sits on eleven sites of different shapes and heights: crowns, shelves and terraces, a crescent crest, a palace spur, an arena bowl, a cascade of garden terraces, a monastery mesa; with cathedrals, basilicas, a great castle, plazas and statues everywhere, and bridges at shared levels tying them together, above all a statue-lined bridge from the Rival Cathedral to the Great Castle. Same layout as the Blender build (scripts/blender/sh_world.py); regenerate with scripts/blender/sh_recipe.py.

views.name: Under the umbrella
views.note: The under city: 99% of the people, houses stacked up the valleys in a maze round the cliffs and benches, the great bridges of the upper city roofing it.

views.name: Two cities
views.note: The whole hold: a maze of valleys full of the under city, eleven peaks of every shape carrying the upper city at different heights, bridges tying them together.

views.name: The statue bridge
views.note: A kilometre of bridge lined with statues on both sides, from the Rival Cathedral to the Great Castle.

views.name: The Great Castle
views.note: The castle at the end of the bridge: two rings of walls, a great keep, spired towers.

views.name: The arena
views.note: An arena sunk into the bowl, ringed by palazzi.

views.name: The cathedral peak
views.note: The first cathedral on its crown, looking over the west and main valleys.

views.name: The dam and the lake
views.note: The glacial lake held above the old city by the dam.
